reviews_list.batch_info: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Infrastructure and placements are good.

review_content.Placements: I am from the 2015-2016 batch, and all the students passed in 2020. The average salary offered is Rs. 40,000 per month. We did internships in PHC and RH, and after this, we can do PG for specifications. After specification, students can run OPD or work as teachers in the respective faculty.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite good. There is a library, labs, playground, etc. The canteen is good, and sports like cricket are played often. Medical facilities are good, and it includes OPD and IPD. Panchakarma is done by highly skilled doctors, and patient exposure is also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: BAMS - Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Shri K R Pandav Ayurved College and Hospital.

review_content.Placements: So, being an ayurvedic student, there are no placements in any medical field. There is a one-year internship program where, for 6 months, you have to work as an intern in college and for 6 months in any other PSC or hospital. The average cutoff of my college is between the marks of 430 to 520 in NEET as per the year 2024, between the ranks of 2 LPA to 3 LPA average. The college result is 100% in the year 2024 for the final year.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are no hostel facilities in my college, nor are there travel facilities like a bus for students who live far away from the college. There is a canteen which provides good food at a low cost. There are no sports facilities in my college, and building-wise, there is decent infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: Malda Medical College - A Short Review on the MBBS Course.
reviews.review_text: We have 19 departments in our college, such as the Department of Anatomy, Physiology, Psychiatry, Radiology, Medicine, Surgery, Orthopaedics, Biochemistry, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, and Paediatrics. Adequate lab facilities, Wi-Fi, lecture theatres, and a central library containing a plethora of books are available. The hostel is good, accommodating 2 to 3 persons per room, and we are provided with a bed, mattress, study table, chair, and almirah.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of studentfriendly environment, faculty, infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Government. Hostels are allowed for ever MBBS student. 2 stude in a room. Big A. C. lecture theates are present in our college. Wi-Fi is available in the hostels. Labs and library IES are quite good. 2 canteens are available in the college campus and their survices are cheap and best.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with college and surroundings.
reviews.review_text: Everything is not up to date but the lecture theater, practical lab, and library is well-equipped, Wi-Fi in a hostel, and the 1st-year hostel is separate where we have to buy drinking water. Hostel is mainly regulated by seniors but they are helpful and are available 24x7. Multiple canteens are available. Silver nest serves good food. It is a medical college so medical faculty is always available. Football and cricket are played every day. Other games are played seasonally or occasionally.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, and the facilities are awesome.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are big enough to occupy our batch, and even two batches can easily fit in our classroom. Labs are well conditioned with few malfunctions. The library is awesome, and lots of books are there. The quality of food in the mess is average, and it needs improvement. The staff are good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was good. Trauma center will be open here soon. The college has a capacity to supply oxygen for 22 days if the world's oxygen gets depleted. The annual college fee is Rs. 9,000 and the hostel fee is Rs.12,000. The college has an awesome library with all kind of required books. The hostel has a table tennis board for sports.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Malda Medical College And Hospital ,Malda.
reviews.review_text: We had Wi-Fi on campus. The lab was neat and clean. The food offered was very healthy. The canteen and medical facilities were available. Cricket and badminton were popular sports in this country.

reviews.review_heading: A medical surgeon who wants to help all, who can't afford valuable medicines.
reviews.review_text: There are 2 libraries ( 1 for gents & other one for girls ), Wi-Fi faculty also available there, classrooms are really big enough for us, there is a canteen available for all of us, there is also a lab room, there is a play ground for us, the food system which delivers to us also good quality & quantity.

individual_reviews.title: My college is good and affordable.

content.Placements: I do not know very much about placements. I have seen some portfolios of pass-out students who got placements in Millennium Company. individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Machine Design - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: My lovely college Millennium Group of Institution.

content.Placements: From the 5th semester, students are eligible for campus placements. Various companies visited the college for placements. Most companies offer a salary package that ranges from 2.5-6 LPA. The highest salary package offered in the college was 15 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 2.5 LPA. Mostly, 65% of students get placement.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good and all facilities are provided for staff members and students. Cleanliness is given first priority in this institute. The institute library is good for studies. Classrooms are also well-furnished and large. A projector is also available for video lectures.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied due to the environment and good faculty.

content.Placements: In this college, 70% of students get placed, and the lowest package is 2 LPA, while the highest package is 6-6.5 LPA, with an average of around 4 LPA. In this course, you can get opportunities in your future, such as becoming a DI. Companies like Cipla and Sunflower are involved in the placement process.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are very good and helpful to students, whether they are first-year or last-year students. There are different facilities present for different subjects, and there are 4-5 labs for various subjects, such as a chemistry lab and a pharmaceutics lab. There are three libraries: two in pharmacy and one in engineering. In MGI, there is a hospital with a medicine room and beds for patients. There are no girls' or boys' hostels on campus. The canteen is also in good condition, providing milk, cold drinks, and other food items. There is a basketball ground on the campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Lateral entry B. Tech students' fee is only 15,000 per year; that's good. Self-study is required.

content.Placements: Here, placement fees are 5000, and the placement companies are not coming; even 1-3 minor companies come, and the college is not ready for the placement. Even teachers are not excited about getting placements. Passed-out students are giving very negative feedback to new students who really want to study.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is good; new buildings are created, and there is good space to study. The new labs are there, but teachers are not interested in teaching. Wi-Fi is available with good speed, and bus facilities are also available. Security guards are good and very strict.

college_info.intro:
Goa University offers several Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Diploma, Certificate, and PhD courses to students. These courses are offered across Science, Management, Commerce, etc streams. Courses like MBA, BTech, MSc are some of popular courses among the students. BTech is offered at UG level for the durationn of 4 years. It is offered in several streams. Students are given multiple placement opportunitites to work in both private & public sectors.
MBA is a two year post graduate program leading to the MBA degree in the areas of Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, Operations or Business Analytics. It prepares students for a career in management & helps students to get knowledge through research and consultancy. Several internships & job opportunities are given to the students. Top recruiting companies in various fields come to the campus to hire students in number of Management, Finance, Hr, etc roles.
Msc is another popular PG level programme. MSc in Biotechnology, Botany, Microbiology, Zoology, Marine Biotechnology, etc are given to the students. All the major facilities required for the course like Laboratories, Library, etc are given to the students. After completing the programme students can go in the fields of Agriculture, Pharmacy, or Research & Development. MA is also a popular programme offered in the fields of Humanities, Sciences, etc.

Goa University has over 10 schools of study. It offers Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Diploma, Certificate, and PhD courses to students. These courses are offered across Science, Management, Commerce, etc. streams.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fees for BA at Goa University?
overview_faqs.answer: Fees for a three-year BA programme offered at Goa University ranges between INR 4,600 and INR 19,300 depending upon the specialisation selected by candidates. Apart from tuition fees, you need to pay hostel fees and, one-time fees during the time of admission.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: College offers good academics and fair placements.

content.Placements: B.Com for. Agnel College of Arts & Commerce (2022-2025). Around 60% students were placed. Packages range from 2-6 LPA, with an average of 3-3.5 LPA. Recruiters included TCS, Infosys, banks and CA firms. About 55% students secured internships in accounting, finance and corporate roles.
content.Infrastructure: The college offered well-maintained classrooms, Wi-Fi, computer labs and a well-stocked library supporting academic needs. Hostel facilities were clean and secure, and the mess and canteen food were hygienic and satisfactory. Basic medical support and good indoor and outdoor sports facilities were available.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Facilities are good. There are good teachers in all departments.

content.Placements: Our college has around 70 percent placements with a package that ranges from 5-6 LPA. A few students got a package of 12 LPA last year. Companies like Infosys, TCS, Wipro, etc., hire students. The average package offered is 3 LPA for very few students.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is modern now. More new PCs and high-end PCs are available for AI and ML students. There is a hostel only for girls. Laboratories have equipment, which is used for academics. The library is very good and well-maintained. Most of the books are available there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Culinary Arts - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Review of V.M. Salgaocar Institute of International Hospitality Education.

content.Placements: Established hotel brands, such as Taj, Marriott, and Accor, among others, visit the campus recruitment placements. It explore further work opportunities in India for their Management Trainee programs. Everyone from my batch finds their internship with the help of the institute.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities provided by the institute are outstanding. They are up to date with the ever-growing world of hospitality. They are essential for working in the world’s finest hotels and establishments. Classrooms having a smart TV, projector, laptop, and speaker. Library has a wide collection of books that are updated every few weeks. It is vast to help students learn in depth about different subjects, ranging from Food Production to Hospitality Law, and other important books that are relevant to the course. Food is hygienically prepared, nutritious, and delicious. The hostel is also well equipped with furniture.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Culinary Arts - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I'm absolutely satisfied with the institute.

content.Placements: A total of 23 students in my batch, making it an amazing experience to learn and grow. The highest package that I have seen my senior get is 42 LPA. Major recruiting companies are Taj, Marriott, Hilton, and Marthinal Portugal. In my course, all the students got an opportunity for internships in Portugal. As I am in the culinary field, the roles offered depend on the experience we gain, and it all depends on how you mould yourself for the future.
content.Infrastructure: I personally would say the institute has one of the best top-class infrastructures. And would inform all the students interested in visiting the institute and checking it. All the classrooms are air-conditioned. The quality of food is good, offering different types of meals every day. For example, one day veg meals, the next day non-veg meals.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in International Hospitality Management - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with my decision to join VMSIIHE.

content.Placements: We received multiple opportunities when it came to internships and as well as job placements. Internship we were placed in several properties in Portugal and India. Job placements included hotel brands from India Portugal UAE and many more.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is top notch. There are spacious classrooms an IT lab, Library with all the necessary study material along with other books for readers. The kitchen and Restaurant for practical classes gave us the real world experience. Wi-fi is available throughout the campus. The quality of meals provided is excellent with a proper balanced diet and good quality raw materials. We had sports once a week along with an annual sports day which included table tennis football basketball and swimming etc.

reviews.review_heading: I am really disappointed with the placements.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi, cafeteria, or parking. In my college, area is very small and poor infrastructure. There is no proper action for students problems, and they are not willing to rectify the students issues. There are some teachers who are showing partiality with the students.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good faculty members, but the infrastructure is below average.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are not good. There is no hostel in our college, and there isn't even a canteen for our college. Our college has an old building. The labs are not good, and they have the required materials, but their maintenance is average.

reviews.review_heading: I don't know about 2015, but now our college has totally changed.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The labs and library are well-maintained. There is no hostel available for this college. The department is so good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members, students and college are very good.
reviews.review_text: For our department, canteen is available, but a playground is not available. If you want to play, then our engineering college ground is available here to play. In our hostel, they serve fried rice and chicken and weekly two times non-vegetarian, and Wi-Fi and ambulance are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Teachers, infrastructure, facilities, etc., are good.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure was good, and they have a library and lab facilities. Hostel rooms were excellent. Canteen is also very good, and food facilities and water facilities are also good. They provided drinking water and bathing water, but problems arise regularly. In summer, the container water tank is provided.

College is good and the classes are normal, while the Practical were a source knowledge. Faculty is well qualified, but some lacked the teaching expertise. College is very eco-friendly with trees all around. It has other courses/disciplines like Arts and Architecture. It also offers a range of pharmacy courses. It is affiliated to Osmania University. reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty members of our college.
